basic_info.description: Welcome to Tower Residence 513. This pride of ownership residence offers 5 Star features that include wood flooring throughout and like new high end finishes. The open concept great room has large windows with courtyard outlooks. The gourmet kitchen features premium Domus & Domus integrated cabinetry with matched refrigerator and dishwasher. The top of the line Gaggenau appliances include: a 5 burner gas cooktop and convection oven. The master bedroom suite has a walk-in closet and an ensuite bath with dual sink vanity. The bedrooms are separated. Parking is included. One Mission Bay is a full service building with 24/7 lobby ambassadors and concierge services. The life style amenities are second to none and include: a heated outdoor pool and hot tub, poolside cabanas, private outdoor dining and courtyard BBQ, resident lounge, private meeting room, biz center, library, guest suites, fitness center and more. Live walking distance to Oracle Park, Chase Center- home of the Golden State Warriors, parks,restaurants and shopping. There's easy access to freeways. Live at One Mission Bay in Mission Bay - SF's newest and most vibrant neighborhood.
